TEXT:
The game project for the cultural festival is doing 
well, the Akagi siblings are on better terms. Finally, 
the countdown to boobs steadily approaches.

It appeared that everything around me is going 
smoothly.

However, with summer vacation nearing its end and 
the second semester of school starting up, the 
game production is at its climax on this certain day...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
...So, if this cutscene is added here, it would be 
easier for players new to the RPG genre to 
understand it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Amazing! Makabe-senpai, you made that in such 
short notice?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Not at all, I only ported bits and pieces from the 
collaboration with the club president, along with 
some of my programming.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
While it's up to you to make the contents 
interesting, I'll do all the back-end support I can.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: How reliable... Wonderful, Senpai!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Hahaha, don't praise me so much, it's embarrassing.

I casually sent an invitation, "Wanna check out at 
the club room?", but things are about to take a 
turn for the worse.

After seeing his lovely little sister and a guy talking 
like that, Akagi went berserk in an instant.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: It's him... I'm sure it's him...! I finally found him!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hey, what are you doing in front of our clubroom?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [font_size=33]Kousakaaaaaa!!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=28]Ahhhh!! Don't throw yourself at me while 
crying! That's creepy![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: But Sena-chaaaaaan!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Don't throw a tantrum, calm down. We completed 
phase one of Sena's situation, right? I even texted 
you with, "She doesn't have anyone she likes."

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Yeah! Right after receiving your text, Sena gave 
me a present. It was a blissful moment, getting a 
gift from an angel♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah? That's good. Let's leave it at that then.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
I'm not done yet, don't push me aside, 
Kousaka[font_size=23]a[/font_size][font_size=24]a[/font_size][font_size=25]a[/font_size][font_size=26]a[/font_size][font_size=26]a[/font_size][font_size=27]![/font_size][font_size=28]![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ahh, geez! I got it, I'll tell you about what's going 
on, so stop clinging onto me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hello, Senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What's with that stare?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
All those stories, I had no doubt that they were 
merely her delusions, but... Senpai, you're really...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Of course not!! Stop backing away already, I'm 
begging you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: P-Please don't go embracing one another in public.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's no embrace! I was being grabbed by him.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
W-Whatever the case, I'll be in the club room. 
Please finish your lover's quarrel at once.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
What's this turn of events... This rotten ocean of 
misunderstandings is spreading far and wide 
around me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Well you're a natural M, there's no avoiding it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=33]This is 100% your fault![/font_size] Get off 
me already! And why are you 
even here!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Ah yeah, let's continue from where we left off! 
Kousaka, you know me... I've been keeping Sena's 
present closeby, look!

Akagi pulls a game out of his bag. And don't keep it 
on your person, that's not a handheld game.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: And?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
But guess what... Sena was acting a bit weird that 
day. It was like her mind was in another place...

It was probably buried within the rotten ocean, 
knowing her.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
So that's why I'm asking, who the heck is this 
person?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Who...? Ah, Makabe? He's a second year in our club.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
That's him! The pest that's been stalking Sena 
everywhere! I know it!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Huh? Didn't I resolve that issue for you? How long 
are you gonna keep this up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
As long as he lives, we're nowhere near a solution! 
He was talking to her earlier like they were close, 
that brat...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I don't know what you're going on about, but I 
have stuff to do in the club room. Have fun with 
your conspiracies. See ya.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: His face and voice are nice, so it's gotta be him...!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Just how are you coming to that conclusion...

Ignoring Akagi's spouting of curses, I opened the 
clubroom door.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Kousaka-senpai, you're late.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, something came up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes, something...

As I sneaked a peek while pretending to look away, 
Kuroneko glared at me coldly. Thanks to Akagi, yet 
another annoyance surfaced...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Well, the club president isn't here yet, so isn't it fine?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: Yo.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: Ah, so everyone's here already?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yup.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Huh? Don't we have one person too many? There's 
someone behind you two...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

I followed my gaze towards where Makabe 
pointed, it was...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=44]Geh![/font_size]
Akagi! He followed me inside!
